content.text:
**Finding submitted — deviation (GOVLAW).**

- **Governing law:** Section 10.5 already selects New York law, which sits at our preferred position; no change made there.
- **Forum:** No jurisdiction, venue or arbitration provision exists anywhere in the Agreement (Article 10 runs 10.1–10.8 and ends at the signature block), so the venue element fails at both preferred and fallback level.
- **Cure:** One insert after Section 10.5 granting exclusive jurisdiction to the state and federal courts in New York County over the merits, with a carve-out only for temporary injunctive relief. Existing choice-of-law wording preserved verbatim.
